t: You're at Rutland Gate, in Knightsbridge, just south of Hyde Park. It's a double garden square shaped like an hourglass, built on the former land of Rutland House, and it includes a number of listed buildings. The banker Frederick Huth Jackson, who lived from 1863 to 1921, lived here. He was a partner in the merchant bank Frederick Huth and Company, which was founded by his great-grandfather, and he became a privy councillor.
